groupby_q6.chdb: SELECT id4, id5, median(v3), stddevSamp(v3) FROM data GROUP BY id4, id5
groupby_q6.datafusion: SELECT id4, id5, median(v3), stddev(v3) FROM data GROUP BY id4, id5

groupby_q6.rayforce: # NYI: rayforce engine does not support median + multi-key by()

groupby_q7.chdb: SELECT id3, max(v1) - min(v2) FROM data GROUP BY id3
groupby_q7.datafusion: SELECT id3, max(v1) - min(v2) FROM data GROUP BY id3
groupby_q7.duckdb: SELECT id3, MAX(v1) - MIN(v2) FROM data GROUP BY id3
groupby_q7.questdb: SELECT id3, MAX(v1) - MIN(v2) FROM data GROUP BY id3
groupby_q7.rayforce:
# Two-stage workaround for engine NYI on arithmetic-of-aggregates per-group:
agg = t.select(v1m=Column("v1").max(), v2m=Column("v2").min()).by("id3").execute()
agg.select("id3", range_v1_v2=Column("v1m") - Column("v2m")).execute()
groupby_q7.timescale: SELECT id3, MAX(v1) - MIN(v2) FROM data GROUP BY id3

groupby_q8.chdb: SELECT id6, v3 FROM (SELECT id6, v3, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id6 ORDER BY v3 DESC) rn FROM data WHERE v3 IS NOT NULL) WHERE rn <= 2

groupby_q8.rayforce: # NYI: rayforce-py has no top-N / per-group head(n)
groupby_q8.timescale: SELECT id6, v3 FROM (SELECT id6, v3, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id6 ORDER BY v3 DESC) rn FROM data WHERE v3 IS NOT NULL) sub WHERE rn <= 2
